title: Atwood Machine
description: Interactive simulation of the classic Atwood machine demonstrating Newton's second law with two connected masses over a frictionless pulley. Users can adjust mass values and observe the resulting acceleration and tension.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: physics

Atwood machine
acceleration
tension
